## SetupOptions.skipTrust property

Development-only escape hatch: set to `true` to deliberately skip executable-trust (TOFU) verification. The minted token carries no executable identity binding.

**Signature:**

```typescript
skipTrust?: boolean | undefined;
```

## Remarks

\*\*Security warning:\*\* a token minted with `skipTrust: true` is not bound to any calling executable, so any process that obtains the JWE can redeem it. Use this only in local development or tests — never in production. Prefer [SetupOptions.executablePath](./vaultkeeper.setupoptions.executablepath.md) so executable trust is actually enforced.

Mutually exclusive with [SetupOptions.executablePath](./vaultkeeper.setupoptions.executablepath.md)<!-- -->: providing both throws [ExecutableTrustRequiredError](./vaultkeeper.executabletrustrequirederror.md)<!-- -->.
